D1-M19: Cappadocian Riders held the 3 VP centre in each of Rounds 1-4 (12 of their 32 VP) with Dragoon Brethren as the anchor, and the Brethren shot Horns of Hattin's first Troop Requisition dead the round it arrived. In Round 5 Crimson Knights 2, under Agnus Dei, destroyed Khassakiyya Guard 1 and the west flipped: the Riders passed 30 although Horns of Hattin maxed LEAD FROM THE FRONT at 10.
D1-M20: Silver Arrow Brethren 1 and 2 destroyed four of Alea Iacta's seven starting units in two rounds - the Champion of Mars, the Speculatores and both Legionnaire Squads - and Brethren 2 shot Alea Iacta's HQ dead in Round 5. Ironthunder Vanguard 2 held the centre for three rounds, but Popinjay Guild held the east all six. The first playing went the other way, 6-32.
D1-M21: Flamewrought Company held the centre every round and destroyed nine Belfry Battery units (177 RP) for two. Javidan Immortals 1 and Ardashir broke the Knight-Apostle Squad in Round 2; cheap Sagdid Hound-Keepers and Shieldbearers then took every objective while the gun line died. The Battery held no objective after Round 2.
D1-M22: Soudarion Cortege took all three objectives in Round 1 and held at least two every round. Sepulchre Guard 2 with Lazarite Prelate 2 held the west for three rounds and killed Muqatila Troopers 2 and Naqib 2 for MAN OF THE HOUR. The 10 VP round cap withheld 10 VP from the Cortege in Rounds 3 and 4, and it still finished in Round 4. The first playing went the other way, 25-33.
D1-M23: Longwu Army's two Vermillion Rocket Batteries did 84 damage (Battery 2 alone 62, the most of any unit on the Day's last six) and burned away every Cultist and Lucent screen. Ten Commandery Bannermen squads held the objectives and scored IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS every round: Longwu hit the 10 VP cap in Rounds 2-4. Tithe of Torment fed the Goetic Ophanim three Fractured Horizons for 37 damage, but three CHARACTERS could not out-OC the Bannermen.
D1-M24: Scorpion Shields won Round 1 and lost the battle in Round 2: a 3 CP Countercharge sent the Golgothic Paladins into the Marshal pair, Praetorian Tribune 1 and Praetorian Strikers 1, and destroyed both. From Round 3 the Miserere Column's Levies held all three objectives. Scorpion Shields destroyed no enemy unit all battle and lost five (170 RP).
